## ④ Notes

- **Writes.** They go through the fleet-write relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. One dispatch of N actions counts as one write, and `automerge_enable` enqueues.
- **Commit trailers.** Harness model-name trailers are reported only, per objectui `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:285`. History is never rewritten.
- **Review records.** Before posting a reviewer's record, fix any `Served-tier` line that carries a model id to the constant name.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate.** It compiles against objectstack `main`, not the pin. Every PR touching spec-derived types must type-check against a spec built from `main`, via `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject`. #10273 and #10307 each needed a forward-compat fix.
- **Next spec bump will red these.** Recorded, not filed:

  - core `normalize-list-view.pageResidual-8429.test.ts` (TS2344)
